page: OVHcloud r2-240 is a memory-optimized cloud server built for data-heavy workloads requiring substantial system memory relative to processing cores. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance supplies 16 dedicated x86_64 physical cores (16 vCPUs without hyperthreading) powered by an Intel Haswell processor clocked at 2.2 GHz. The hardware package is provisioned with 240 GB of RAM, translating to an expansive 15 GB per core. Bundled hardware resources include 400 GB of local SSD storage and a 10 Gbps baseline network interface, while no dedicated graphics accelerators are present.

Benchmark results highlight an architecture oriented toward distributed memory capacity rather than raw single-threaded speed. The older Haswell architecture posts modest single-core throughput, reflected in a Geekbench single-core score of 1005 and a stress-ng single-core rating in the bottom tier. However, multi-threaded metrics remain stable across mid-range thresholds, scoring 5645 in Geekbench multi-core and 13060.59 in the PassMark CPU test. Memory tests register uncached read bandwidth at 40.15 GB/sec alongside a write throughput of 21.66 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of the r2-240 is its reliance on legacy core architecture with low single-core execution speed in exchange for high memory capacity per core. For CPU-bound tasks or advanced vector instruction sets, processing efficiency is constrained. Conversely, for memory-resident datasets, the instance provides strong resource density, reaching 12.22 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and delivering 7.38 GB/sec in static web throughput.

The OVHcloud r2-240 is well suited for memory-intensive architectures including large-scale in-memory caching layers, Redis deployments, intermediate ETL staging, and distributed databases that require significant RAM capacity over per-core clock speed.

Powered by the KVM hypervisor, it features 16 dedicated x86_64 cores operating at 2.2 GHz on Intel Haswell architecture, accompanied by 240 GB of system RAM—providing 15 GB of memory per core. The server configuration includes 400 GB of local SSD storage and a 10 Gbps network connection, with no discrete GPU. Benchmark results demonstrate average multi-threaded execution alongside constrained single-threaded performance, typical of its generation. Memory operations sustain 40.15 GB/sec uncached read throughput, while Redis benchmarks yield 12.22 million SET operations per second. This profile presents a cost-effective tradeoff for operations prioritizing total memory footprint over peak compute frequencies. OVHcloud r2-240 is best matched for in-memory databases, Redis caches, memory-bound data analysis, and large web application tiers.
